title: Bora Employer Pipeline Claim Record
description: Canonical Level-2 approved claim record. A claim is a human-reviewed statement supported by one or more evidence records. It must never invent outcomes, upgrade evidence certainty, or omit evidence lineage.

claim_id.description: Permanent unique Claim_ID for this reusable claim.

wording.description: Approved claim wording. Must remain faithful to cited evidence and must not introduce unsupported scope or fabricated outcomes.

evidence_ids.description: One or more Evidence_ID values that support this claim. Empty lists are forbidden. No Evidence_ID means no factual claim.

evidence_state.description: Evidence certainty state for the claim. Uses only the locked Blueprint evidence states. Must not silently upgrade certainty.

allowed_contexts.description: Contexts in which this claim may be used, such as resume, networking, or interview. Empty array means no allowed context has been approved yet.

forbidden_contexts.description: Contexts in which this claim must not be used. Empty array when no explicit forbidden context is recorded.

human_approval.description: Explicit human approval flag. True only when a human has approved this claim. Must never be inferred, defaulted, or omitted.

date.description: Date associated with this claim version, typically the approval or last-reviewed date.

version.description: Version identifier for this claim wording/approval record.
